title: Customer-Local Eval Operator and Privacy Telemetry Gates
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Customers running Dedicated or Private deployments need per-tenant eval suites that run close to their data without exporting sensitive corpora. We must provide a managed operator and telemetry gating that allows customers to run local evals (golden prompts, reference corpora) and surface regression signals to Redwood without exposing raw customer data

Goal: Ship a Customer-Local Eval Operator (K8s operator + lightweight agent for on-prem/VPC) plus privacy-preserving telemetry gates so: (1) customers can run pinned eval suites locally, (2) Redwood receives aggregate regression alerts and diffs, and (3) no raw customer prompts/responses leave customer networks unless explicitly consented and encrypted for transfer.

This ticket scopes product-level acceptance criteria, success metrics, and initial rollout plan for pilot customers. Engineering will own operator implementation; security will sign off on telemetry gates.
acceptance_criteria: Operator deploys as Helm/manifest with documented resource requirements and RBAC rules
Customer can register a local eval suite from Console without uploading raw test data to Redwood
Agent computes eval results locally and sends only per-assertion hashes, aggregate scores, and diff summaries to Redwood telemetry endpoints
Telemetry API exposes regression alerts in Console with links to a customer-only runbook and ability to mute/fork the suite locally
Security review completed and KMS/HSM guidance documented for optional upload of encrypted golden sets
Pilot with 2 Dedicated customers and 1 Private on-prem completes with non-functional metrics validated (latency, throughput, storage)
End-to-end documentation and onboarding checklist published in Confluence and Console help
tasks: Define operator resource model and config schema (eng + infra)
Design telemetry gate: hashed assertions, differential sketches, and privacy budget constraints
Console UI: modal to register local eval endpoint and manage consent/keys
Create migration path for customers with existing evals to migrate to local operator
Prepare pilot plan and success criteria with two customers (legal/CS coordination)
Draft security runbook and KMS integration docs
Implement initial API for aggregated alerts and test with synthetic data
decisions: Use a local agent + gRPC control plane instead of a fully managed remote runner to avoid data egress by default
Telemetry will be additive aggregates and cryptographic hashes of assertions; raw text export is opt-in and requires dual approval (customer + Redwood security)
Operator will support both namespace-scoped and cluster-scoped installs to accommodate varied customer security models
tradeoffs: Local evals reduce central visibility and slow Redwood's ability to triage regressions; mitigated by richer aggregated telemetry and a debug escrow flow
Adding privacy-preserving sketches increases complexity for accuracy of regression detection—accept approximate diffs for initial release
Supporting on-prem increases QA surface and maintenance cost but is required for high-security customers
